task.description: Validate all 4 design docs for ISS-401..404. Hard gate.
acceptance_criteria: Every ISS-401..404 acceptance criterion has a design element in its doc
No implementation code present in any doc
ISS-401: sliding-window, rate-limit key structure, 429+Retry-After, config validation all covered
ISS-402: OIDC cache key strategy, JWKS validation, revocation mechanism covered
ISS-403: OIDC principal rate-limit key derivation covered
ISS-404: token role snapshot semantics, immutability after issuance covered

result.summary: All 4 design docs validated. Lint passes on iss401, iss402, iss403, iss404. Each doc covers all acceptance criteria: iss401 (sliding-window, key structure, backend, 429+Retry-After, config validation), iss402 (JWKS validation, (realm,jti) cache with TTL, jti denylist, realm logout), iss403 (OIDC rate-limit key from (tenant_id, realm, sub), local key from api_token.id), iss404 (token roles snapshot at issuance, user_roles change does not affect issued tokens). No implementation code present.
